the outer face of a c-planar clustered graph is uniquely determined by its root.

we have shown that the root of the cluster tree is a natural choice for the outer face of a clustered graph.
the outer face of a clustered graph can be chosen independently of the root of its inclusion tree and vice versa.

the root of the clustering is a crucial factor for the c-planarity of a clustered graph.
the root of the tree is the key to the planarity of the underlying graph.
